meta.title: Drogi Mikołaju – a magical Secret Santa
meta.description: Draw Secret Santa with family, friends or colleagues, hosted by Santa himself.

home.title: Turn the name draw into a show
home.modesTitle: Two ways to draw your Secret Santa

sync.title: A live draw, together or from afar
sync.body: Santa runs the draw live. Whoever’s in the room watches on the big screen, and whoever’s far away watches the same show on their phone or laptop. The result still stays secret: each of you only sees your own match.

async.title: A fully remote draw
async.body: For busy elves. Invite family and friends by sharing a link. Once everyone has said they’re in, the draw happens remotely and each person finds out who they’re giving a gift to when the moment is right. The same Christmas magic, even when the run-up to the holidays keeps you busy.

home.footer: Made in Santa’s workshop. Ho ho ho!
home.heroLead: Santa hosts your Secret Santa, draws the names fairly and whispers each match to the right phone.
home.matchBody: Hold the stocking to unwrap it. Only you see the name, so the neighbours can’t peek. Try it here.
home.languagesBody: The whole show, Santa’s voice included, in five languages. Pick yours.
home.finaleBody: Set it up in a minute. Everyone else joins with a code or a quick scan of the QR.
home.joinHint: Type the 6-character code from the organiser, or paste your invite link.
home.codeNotFound: We don’t know that code. Check it with the organiser.

ceremony.lobby1: Ho, ho, ho! Come in, come in, and warm your hands by the fire. Scan the code to join my workshop.
ceremony.welcome1: Ho, ho, ho! Good evening, my dear friends!
ceremony.welcome2: It is me, Santa Claus. Tonight my workshop is all yours. My helpers have tidied up, baked you some cookies and warmed up the cocoa.
ceremony.welcome3: I can see {count, plural, one {one new elf} other {# new elves}} here.
ceremony.elves1: Let me take a good look at you all.
ceremony.elves2: What a splendid team! Every single one of you is on my nice list this year.
ceremony.elvesRemote: And the warmest greetings to those joining us from afar: {names}. Christmas magic works across any distance.
ceremony.rules1: Now for the workshop rules. Each of you will secretly get the name of one person to surprise with a gift this year.
ceremony.rulesExclusions: Of course, nobody will draw themselves, and the Elf Chief has made sure some pairs skip each other, so every surprise stays a surprise. Mrs Claus and Rudolph are keeping an eye on a fair draw.
ceremony.rulesNoSelf: Of course, nobody will draw themselves. Mrs Claus and Rudolph are keeping an eye on a fair draw.
ceremony.rulesBudget: The gift should cost no more than {budget}. What counts is a good idea, a little flair and a pinch of glitter.
ceremony.rulesNoBudget: We haven't set a limit on what a gift should cost, but remember: the best gifts come straight from the heart. What counts is a good idea, a little flair and a pinch of glitter.
ceremony.rules2: And most important of all: keep your result a secret!
ceremony.draw1: Elves, to your places! Let the great draw begin!
ceremony.draw2: The names are spinning, the bells are ringing, and the big stocking takes over the wheel of fortune…
ceremony.draw3: Done! Every name has found its elf.
ceremony.reveal1: Now, look at your own device, and hold it close to your chest.
ceremony.reveal2: Hold the gift to unwrap it. Shh, not a word to anyone!
ceremony.farewell1: That's the end of the draw, but don't let the Christmas spirit leave you. We've put together a few playlists of Christmas hits for you to enjoy.
ceremony.farewell2: Thank you for visiting my workshop. Merry Christmas, my dear elves! Ho, ho, ho!
ceremony.personal2: The elves have finished the great draw, and I have a little secret just for you.
ceremony.personal3: Are you ready? Here it comes…
ceremony.personalReveal: This year, {receiver} is the person you will surprise with a Christmas gift!
ceremony.personalBye: Keep it secret, keep it merry. Ho, ho, ho!
